Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses All Vendors intending to participate in the bid must have to deposit sample of Hard-Coke before the chairp erson of the committee after technical verification. • The bidder should have to submit the PAN Card. • The bidder should have to submit the GST Certificate. • The bidder should have to submit the latest GST clearance certificate. • The bidder should have to submit the Income Tax return of last 3 years. · Certificate of Technical Specification compliance to be submitted on company letter head as acceptance. · The bidder should compulsory be coal commodity merchandizer and a certificate duly issued against the f irm by ministry of coal be uploaded. • Income tax/ Service tax/ GST as applicable shall be deducted at the source from the payment. • The quoted rates shall include delivery of the entire quantity of 1800 quintals of Hard coke at the design ated consignee location i.e DPL Kupwara including freight, taxes and other applicable charges as per appli able Gem terms. • The bidder should quote the rate inclusive of all taxes. • The bidder should have to submit the turnover certificate of last 3 years and same should be issued by th e Chartered Accountant. • Undertaking for non-blacklisting on company letterhead. • Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents in the Techni cal Evaluation.

• After placement of supply order, a committee shall be constituted at the unit levelheaded by Gazetted of ficer to certify that the supply hard coke, charcoal, rejection wood is as per the specification mentioned in bid document. • The committee shall take random samples of each lot for quality check from accredited laboratory the lo ts against which satisfactory report is received shall be taken as stock. • All legal proceedings arising out of any dispute between parties shall have to be instituted in the courts s ituated in Kupwara jurisdiction only. • 100% payment will be made on submission of invoices after successful completion. EMD in shape of CDR shall be pledged to Accounts Officer SSP Office Kupwara. Moreover, participant bidders have to submit random sample of the hard coke to the chairperso n of the committee on Prebid meet which is scheduled on 09/11/2026 (whole day) for testing purpose so t hat actual report could be taken from the concerned authority. . 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document.
